title: OpenSpec Stack Profile
description: Schema for the `stack:` section of openspec/config.yaml consumed by `opsx-dev-pipeline doctor --stack`. Mirrors the validation performed by src/core/doctor/checkStackHealth.ts and the StackId values defined in src/core/adapters/types.ts.

id.description: Stable identifier for the stack profile. Must match one of the StackId values defined in src/core/adapters/types.ts.

languages.description: Programming languages used by the stack (e.g. ["typescript", "python"]). An empty array triggers a warning in checkStackHealth.

services.description: Logical services that compose the stack. Each entry's `path` must exist on disk relative to the project root.

verify.description: Optional top-level verification commands (build / smoke / contract).

path.description: Directory containing the service, expressed relative to the project root. checkStackHealth requires this path to exist on disk.

command.description: Shell command descriptor. `command` is the shell snippet to execute; `cwd` (if set) is resolved against the project root and must be an existing directory; `env` is an optional map of additional environment variables.
Shell command to run. Empty `command` is allowed when `required: false`; with `required: true` an empty string is treated as an error by checkStackHealth.

cwd.description: Working directory for the command, relative to the project root. If set, checkStackHealth requires the directory to exist on disk.

env.description: Extra environment variables injected when the command runs. Keys are variable names; values are stringified before being passed to the shell.

required.description: When true, an empty `command` is reported as an error by checkStackHealth instead of being silently ignored.
